The House Committee on Governmental Affairs offers Bill 416 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Efstration of the following substitute to HB 416: 104th, Blackmon of the 146th, and Kelley of the 16th
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 88 of Title 36 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to enterprise zones, so as to revise the class of retailer from which fees may be … in effect for the full ten-year period established by Code Section 36-88-8, regardless of the termination of the designation of the enterprise zone."
SECTION 3. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
